# VMTechCraft

> VMTechCraft is the freelance studio of Vinod Mache, a web and software developer based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. It builds business websites, e-commerce stores, custom web apps and business software (billing, inventory, HRMS) for clients in India and worldwide.

- Based in: Pune, Maharashtra, India. Work is delivered remotely for international clients.
- Email: vinod.mache@vmtechcraft.com
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 94030 38498
- Website: https://www.vmtechcraft.com/

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/): Overview of VMTechCraft and its services
- [About](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/about): About Vinod Mache
- [Work](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/work): Portfolio of live client websites
- [Process](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/process): The four-step development process

## Services

- [All services](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/): Web and software development services
- [Business website development](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/business-website-development/): Company and small business websites
- [E-commerce website development](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/ecommerce-website-development/): Online stores
- [Custom web application development](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/custom-web-application-development/): Custom web apps
- [Billing software development](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/billing-software-development/): Billing and invoicing software
- [Management software development](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/management-software-development/): CRM, ERP and HR management software
- [Website redesign](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/website-redesign/): Redesigns of existing websites
- [Website maintenance](https://www.vmtechcraft.com/services/website-maintenance/): Ongoing maintenance and support
